Applications for 2027 Open Aug 17, 2026! *Submit by DECEMBER 1st, 2026 for priority consideration, Late applications accepted and reviewed on a rolling basis!
Information on how to apply to Georgia Tech for graduate school is given on the Graduate Education Admissions page.
Admission Review Criteria
NOTE: The GRE will be optional. (It is not required!)
Institute Graduate Online Application.
The Institute application requires a non-refundable application fee of $95.00 with your application ($105 for international student). If this poses a financial hardship for you, please complete the application and click the button at the end that requests a departmental waiver. Your application will be reviewed and a decision will be made on the waiver request.
Decisions for Fall admission are made starting in December throughout late February.
For International students, Rules on English proficiency requirements and who must complete an English proficiency exam can be found here: https://grad.gatech.edu/english-proficiency Failure to meet GTs English language requirements will result in an automatic denial of your application.
Our admissions review criteria can be found here . For additional questions, please review the Frequently Asked Questions, or contact:
